qa.title: Q2537 (Nov. 6, 2026)
qa.question: If this follower attacks an enemy leader, does its "10 times on each of your turns, when this deals combat damage, refresh it" ability trigger?
qa.answer: No. Damage dealt by an attacking follower to an enemy leader is not considered "combat damage."

qa.title: Q2536 (Nov. 6, 2026)
qa.question: What does "combat damage" mean?
qa.answer: "Combat damage" refers to the damage that an attacking follower and a target follower deal to each other in combat.
